title: On Having no time for argument
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：have　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 have 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the ranger ① had no time for argument in silence, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② has no time for argument twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ have no time for argument at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ had no time for argument before — a line in the survey for October 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Having no time for argument in silence, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ have the yearly gathering in May twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Have the yearly gathering in May at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ has the yearly gathering in May in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ had no time for argument again when nobody else would.

⑩ To have no time for argument, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody has no time for argument twice over again and somebody must have no time for argument in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 有（一般过去式 had no time for argument：1982 年守林人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 有（一般现在 has no time for argument：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 有（不定式 to have no time for argument：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 有（过去完成时 had had no time for argument：1976 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 有（动名词 having no time for argument 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 举办（have the yearly gathering in May：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去举办五月里一年一次的聚会）
G. v. 举办（have the yearly gathering in May：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 有（后段两处：新来的村民照例 has the yearly gathering in May，而母亲又一次 had no time for argument）

items.q: to have no time for argument
had no time for argument before
have the yearly gathering in May twice over
have the yearly gathering in May at once
has the yearly gathering in May in silence
had no time for argument again
to have no time for argument

answers.why: have 意为“有”，1982 年守林人一言不发地有没有争辩的工夫，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 had。
have 意为“有”，自那以后守林人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 has。
have 意为“有”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯有没有争辩的工夫”，此处为不定式 to have no time for argument。
have 意为“有”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人有过，故用过去完成时 had had。
have 意为“有”，守林人说“有没有争辩的工夫这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 having no time for argument 作主语。
have 意为“举办”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去举办五月里一年一次的聚会”，should ever 之后用原形 have the yearly gathering in May。
have 意为“举办”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻举办五月里一年一次的聚会（have the yearly gathering in May at once），以后再也不要提起。
have 意为“有”，新来的村民每个季节都照例举办五月里一年一次的聚会，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 has。
have 意为“有”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地有没有争辩的工夫，用一般过去式 had 叙述。
have 意为“有”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要有没有争辩的工夫，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，守林人一言不发地有没有争辩的工夫；山谷里每一个村民都说这是头一回。（had no time for argument）
多年以后，守林人仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（has no time for argument）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯有没有争辩的工夫这件事本身。（to have no time for argument）
早在 1976 年就有人有没有争辩的工夫，十月那天踏勘记录上的一行字就是证据。（had had no time for argument）
守林人说过，一言不发地有没有争辩的工夫这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（having no time for argument 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻举办五月里一年一次的聚会，以后再也不要提起。（have the yearly gathering in May，祈使句）
answers: In 1982 the ranger had no time for argument in silence, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the ranger still has no time for argument twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to have no time for argument at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had had no time for argument long before 1989, and the line in the survey for October proves it.
Having no time for argument in silence, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Have the yearly gathering in May at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 have 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the ranger had no time for argument in silence, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger has no time for argument twice over whenever the valley asks.
Having no time for argument in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever have the yearly gathering in May twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley has the yearly gathering in May in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother had no time for argument again, and the valley remembered that half.
